The raw variance limit is M_a B_Gamma(z,z), the half action used in the score is (M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z); source 117/136 uses the full raw variance and divides by two only inside the score. Both were returned-explanation errors, not manuscript defects. All original target and join judgments (SC136, SC137, endpoint control, raw-cost positivity, unmasked Rayleigh domain, spatial dilation/optimization, finite-before-rough, FINITE values) remain proved, with the same named-input reading limits and no changed grade.

checks.reason: Conceded: 'globally bounded by local Radon mass' is not a sufficient argument. Local finiteness of a positive tempered Radon measure gives only uniform bounds on compacts, not uniform in x. The discriminator Gamma0=(1+|x|^2)dx is positive tempered Radon with finite local masses, but for nonnegative nonzero compact z the convolution Gamma0*z grows polynomially at infinity. It is not a contrad model: its distributional Fourier transform is (1-Delta)delta0, a signed distribution, so Gamma0 is not positive-definite with a positive spectral measure, and it is not homogeneous of degree d-alpha; hence it lies outside Hypothesis H:homog and does not falsify the source. Correct mechanism: in PROOF136 the mean at s0 equals h_{Psi,s0} for the compact spacetime control Psi(t,x)=c f(t) z(x)/k_f(s0); PROOF128 (global regularity), valid for this exact control, gives 0<=h_{Psi,s}<=M uniformly in x, so ||U_z||_inf=(1/c)h_{Psi,s0}<infinity. The internal global step of 128 is the Gaussian envelope 127: for each mixed derivative DPsi of compact support one has |DPsi(t,x)|<=C_D p_eps(x) pointwise (the centered heat kernel has a positive minimum on the common compact spatial support and stands above DPsi=0 elsewhere); then Gamma*|DPsi(t,.)|(x)<=C_D (Gamma*p_eps)(x)=C_D int e^{i xi x} e^{-eps|xi|^2/2} mu(dxi), and because mu>=0 the absolute value of the oscillatory factor is bounded by one, giving uniformity in x: |(Gamma*p_eps)(x)|<=int e^{-eps|xi|^2/2} mu(dxi)=(Gamma*p_eps)(0)<infinity (temperedness of mu makes the Gaussian weight integrable; strict positivity at zero uses Gamma!=0 and p_eps>0). Thus the global bound uses positivity + positive spectral measure, not mere local Radon mass. The three ingredients stay separate: boundedness gives finiteness lambda_z(c)^2<=c||U_z||_inf; positivity of the rate for every c>0 is independent via 129/118 using C_Gamma L^{-alpha}-D L^{-2}>0 (alpha<2); the positive square-root floor on [c0,1] uses Lambda(c)>=Lambda(c0)=lambda_z(c0)^2>0 and monotonicity. No source defect; only the earlier returned phrasing was a shortcut/error.

Resolved as two distinct quantities. Raw variance: v_{Psi_n}=E[W(Psi_n)^2]=B_Gamma(z,z)*int_0^1 int_0^1 f_n(s)f_n(t)|s-t|^{-a} ds dt = B_Gamma(z,z)*int_0^1 f_n(s)k_n(s) ds, and by monotone convergence (the nonnegative time integrand f_n(s)k_n(s) increases to f_a(s) a.e. interior; the displayed symmetric double integral contains both orderings, so no extra factor 2 or 1/2) this tends to M_a B_Gamma(z,z)>0. Half action: v_{Psi_n}/2 tends to (M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z). These two limits are not equal; only the half appears in a score. Source 117/136 compute and use the full raw variance v_{Psi_n}; the factor 1/2 enters exclusively through the score inequality S1pos>=I_{Psi_n}-v_{Psi_n}/2. Re-deriving the static score: for every fixed n, S1pos (a supremum over the full positive-control class) majorizes I_{Psi_n}-v_{Psi_n}/2; I_{Psi_n}->lambda_z(1) and v_{Psi_n}/2->(M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z), so S1pos>=lambda_z(1)-(M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z), with no monotonicity of the score differences required since both components converge separately. In PROOF137, z=theta(U_ell g)^2 gives B_Gamma(z,z)=theta^2 ell^alpha A (the full raw-variance factor). The cost term actually entering the 136 inequality is (M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z). With ell^2=uL^2/b and theta=(1+u)L^2/(ell^alpha A): (M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z)=(M_a/2)theta^2 ell^alpha A = M_a(1+u)^2 L^4/(2 ell^alpha A) = M_a(1+u)^2 L^{4-alpha}/(2 u^{alpha/2} R(g)) = C(u)L^q. Hence C(u)=M_a(1+u)^2/(2 R(g) u^{alpha/2}); the denominator 2 is exactly the half action. At u*=alpha/q one has 1+u*=4/q and the constant reconciles: q^q C = M_a/(2R)*q^q*(16/q^2)*(q/alpha)^{alpha/2} = 8 M_a q^{q-2+alpha/2}/(R alpha^{alpha/2}) = 8 M_a q^{q/2}/(R alpha^{alpha/2}), using q+alpha/2-2=q/2 (q=4-alpha). This confirms the constant 8 and shows the earlier report sentence '=(M_a/2)B_Gamma(z,z) after the half action' was imprecise returned wording, not a manuscript defect.
